results.generated_sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders
FROM olist_orders_dataset;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS unique_customers
FROM olist_customers_dataset;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_customers
FROM olist_customers_dataset;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT seller_id) AS seller_count
FROM olist_sellers_dataset;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS product_count
FROM olist_products_dataset;

SELECT AVG(review_score) AS average_review_score
FROM olist_order_reviews_dataset;

SELECT MAX(review_score) AS highest_review_score
FROM olist_order_reviews_dataset;

SELECT MIN(review_score) AS lowest_review_score
FROM olist_order_reviews_dataset;

SELECT AVG(price) AS average_price
FROM olist_order_items_dataset;

SELECT MAX(price) AS highest_price
FROM olist_order_items_dataset;

SELECT SUM(freight_value) AS total_freight
FROM olist_order_items_dataset;

SELECT SUM(payment_value) AS total_payment_value
FROM olist_order_payments_dataset;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS payment_record_count
FROM olist_order_payments_dataset;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS review_count
FROM olist_order_reviews_dataset;

SELECT DISTINCT payment_type
FROM olist_order_payments_dataset;

SELECT
    order_id,
    order_item_id,
    product_id,
    seller_id,
    price,
    freight_value
FROM olist_order_items_dataset
ORDER BY price DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT product_id, product_weight_g
FROM olist_products_dataset
ORDER BY product_weight_g DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
    c.customer_id,
    c.customer_unique_id,
    COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM
    olist_customers_dataset AS c
LEFT JOIN
    olist_orders_dataset AS o
    ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY
    c.customer_id,
    c.customer_unique_id
ORDER BY
    order_count DESC;

SELECT
    c.customer_id,
    SUM(p.payment_value) AS total_spending
FROM
    olist_customers_dataset AS c
JOIN
    olist_orders_dataset AS o
    ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN
    olist_order_payments_dataset AS p
    ON o.order_id = p.order_id
GROUP BY
    c.customer_id
ORDER BY
    total_spending DESC;

SELECT
    oi.product_id,
    AVG(oi.price) AS average_item_price
FROM
    olist_order_items_dataset AS oi
GROUP BY
    oi.product_id;

SELECT p.product_category_name AS category_pt,
       t.product_category_name_english AS category_en,
       COUNT(*) AS product_count
FROM olist_products_dataset p
LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation t
  ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
GROUP BY p.product_category_name, t.product_category_name_english
ORDER BY product_count DESC;

SELECT
    oi.seller_id,
    SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS total_revenue
FROM
    olist_order_items_dataset AS oi
GROUP BY
    oi.seller_id
ORDER BY
    total_revenue DESC;

SELECT
    order_status,
    COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM
    olist_orders_dataset
GROUP BY
    order_status
ORDER BY
    order_count DESC;

SELECT
    o.order_status,
    AVG(r.review_score) AS average_review_score
FROM
    olist_orders_dataset AS o
JOIN
    olist_order_reviews_dataset AS r
    ON o.order_id = r.order_id
GROUP BY
    o.order_status
ORDER BY
    o.order_status;

SELECT
    oi.seller_id,
    SUM(oi.freight_value) AS total_freight_value
FROM
    olist_order_items_dataset AS oi
GROUP BY
    oi.seller_id
ORDER BY
    total_freight_value DESC;

SELECT payment_type,
       SUM(payment_value) AS total_payment_amount
FROM olist_order_payments_dataset
GROUP BY payment_type
ORDER BY total_payment_amount DESC;

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
       COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM olist_orders_dataset
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT date_trunc('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
       SUM(oi.price) AS total_item_revenue
FROM olist_order_items_dataset oi
JOIN olist_orders_dataset o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT
    customer_city,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM
    olist_customers_dataset
GROUP BY
    customer_city
ORDER BY
    customer_count DESC;

SELECT seller_id,
       COUNT(*) AS items_sold
FROM olist_order_items_dataset
GROUP BY seller_id
ORDER BY items_sold DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT p.product_category_name,
       AVG(oi.freight_value) AS avg_freight_value
FROM olist_order_items_dataset oi
JOIN olist_products_dataset p
  ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY p.product_category_name
ORDER BY avg_freight_value DESC;

SELECT c.customer_state,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS delivered_orders
FROM olist_orders_dataset o
JOIN olist_customers_dataset c
  ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.customer_state
ORDER BY delivered_orders DESC;

SELECT payment_type,
       AVG(payment_installments) AS average_installments
FROM olist_order_payments_dataset
GROUP BY payment_type
ORDER BY average_installments DESC;

SELECT product_category_name,
       COUNT(*) AS product_count
FROM olist_products_dataset
GROUP BY product_category_name
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1000;

SELECT AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (order_delivered_customer_date - order_purchase_timestamp)) / 86400) AS avg_delivery_days
FROM olist_orders_dataset
WHERE order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
  AND order_status = 'delivered';

SELECT
    review_score,
    COUNT(*) AS review_count
FROM
    olist_order_reviews_dataset
GROUP BY
    review_score
ORDER BY
    review_score;

SELECT COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS category_name,
       SUM(oi.price) AS total_revenue
FROM olist_order_items_dataset oi
JOIN olist_products_dataset p
  ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation t
  ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
GROUP BY COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name)
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT o.customer_id,
       SUM(p.payment_value) AS total_spending
FROM olist_orders_dataset AS o
JOIN olist_order_payments_dataset AS p
  ON o.order_id = p.order_id
GROUP BY o.customer_id
ORDER BY total_spending DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
       AVG(p.order_total) AS average_order_value
FROM olist_orders_dataset o
JOIN (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(payment_value) AS order_total
    FROM olist_order_payments_dataset
    GROUP BY order_id
) p ON o.order_id = p.order_id
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;

SELECT
    p.product_category_name,
    pct.product_category_name_english,
    SUM(oi.price) AS total_sales,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(oi.price) DESC) AS rank
FROM olist_order_items_dataset oi
JOIN olist_products_dataset p
    ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation pct
    ON p.product_category_name = pct.product_category_name
GROUP BY p.product_category_name, pct.product_category_name_english
ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

WITH customer_spending AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id,
           c.customer_unique_id,
           SUM(p.payment_value) AS total_spending
    FROM olist_customers_dataset c
    JOIN olist_orders_dataset o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    JOIN olist_order_payments_dataset p ON o.order_id = p.order_id
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_unique_id
),
avg_spending AS (
    SELECT AVG(total_spending) AS avg_spending
    FROM customer_spending
)
SELECT cs.customer_id,
       cs.customer_unique_id,
       cs.total_spending
FROM customer_spending cs, avg_spending a
WHERE cs.total_spending > a.avg_spending;

SELECT
    order_status,
    COUNT(*) AS order_count,
    ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS order_percentage
FROM olist_orders_dataset
GROUP BY order_status
ORDER BY order_status;

WITH product_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        p.product_id,
        p.product_category_name,
        pc.product_category_name_english,
        SUM(oi.price) AS revenue
    FROM olist_order_items_dataset oi
    JOIN olist_products_dataset p
        ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation pc
        ON p.product_category_name = pc.product_category_name
    GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_category_name, pc.product_category_name_english
)
SELECT
    product_id,
    product_category_name,
    product_category_name_english,
    revenue
FROM (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_category_name ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS rn
    FROM product_revenue
) ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY product_category_name, revenue DESC;

SELECT
    month,
    monthly_revenue,
    SUM(monthly_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS cumulative_revenue
FROM (
    SELECT
        date_trunc('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
        SUM(p.payment_value) AS monthly_revenue
    FROM olist_order_payments_dataset p
    JOIN olist_orders_dataset o ON p.order_id = o.order_id
    GROUP BY month
) AS monthly_totals
ORDER BY month;

SELECT op.order_id,
       SUM(op.payment_value) AS total_payment
FROM olist_order_payments_dataset op
GROUP BY op.order_id
HAVING SUM(op.payment_value) > (
    SELECT AVG(order_total)
    FROM (
        SELECT SUM(payment_value) AS order_total
        FROM olist_order_payments_dataset
        GROUP BY order_id
    ) sub
);

SELECT
    c.customer_id,
    MAX(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS most_recent_order_date,
    COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM olist_customers_dataset AS c
LEFT JOIN olist_orders_dataset AS o
    ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id
ORDER BY c.customer_id;

WITH monthly_rev AS (
    SELECT
        date_trunc('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp)::date AS month,
        SUM(p.payment_value) AS revenue
    FROM olist_orders_dataset o
    JOIN olist_order_payments_dataset p
        ON o.order_id = p.order_id
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
    month,
    revenue,
    revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS mom_change,
    CASE
        WHEN LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE ROUND(((revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month)) / LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month)) * 100, 2)
    END AS mom_pct_change
FROM monthly_rev
ORDER BY month;
